featured_reviews.name: Allwyn Joseph
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a leather belt from this shop, but after a few days, the buckle got damaged. I handed the belt over to them for repair, and it took more than two weeks to get it back. When they returned the belt, I realized that it was not my original belt but one that appeared to belong to another customer, indicating that they had mistakenly exchanged my belt.
They charged me ₹150 for repairing the buckle, but they were unable to return either my original belt or the repair charges. Additionally, the owner of the shop was very arrogant and unprofessional while speaking with me. The overall experience was extremely disappointing.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sir,

We are sorry that you feel dissatisfied with your experience. However, we would like to clarify a few facts regarding this matter.

The belt that was returned to you is the same belt that was received by us for buckle repair. When you informed us that you believed the belt was not yours, we personally contacted you and requested that you visit our store so that we could inspect the belt together. We also offered to provide a replacement belt if it was confirmed that there had been any mistake from our side.

Unfortunately, despite our request, you did not visit the store for verification, which made it difficult for us to resolve the issue. Our intention has always been to provide a fair solution and ensure customer satisfaction.

We respect all customer feedback and remain willing to discuss the matter further. We kindly request that you visit our store so that we can review the issue together and reach an appropriate resolution.

Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: NĪSHANT JADHAV
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Bata Shoe Store in Ghatkopar, and overall, it was a decent experience. The store is well-organized, with a good display of footwear ranging from formal shoes to casual wear, sandals, and sneakers. Bata, being a long-established brand, is known for comfort and durability, and this store lives up to that reputation with a wide variety of options for different age groups.
The staff is generally helpful and assists in finding sizes and suggesting options, although the level of attentiveness can vary depending on how crowded the store is. The trial process is smooth, and billing is fairly quick, which is always appreciated when you’re just trying to buy shoes and leave.
However, pricing can feel slightly on the higher side compared to online platforms, where the same products are often available at discounted rates. During peak hours, the store can get crowded, leading to delays in service and less personalized attention.
Overall, Bata Shoe Store is a reliable place for comfortable and quality footwear. With better pricing consistency and improved service during busy times, the experience could be much more satisfying.
